overview.text: The Executive Engineer, CED-IV, CCU, MoEF&CC, Kolkata is inviting percentage rate bids from CPWD enlisted contractors for the construction of open dais, green room, and washrooms at Phool Bagan in front of CESC Garden, along with repairing/replacing 2km of barbed wire on the boundary wall of AJCBIBG during 2024-25.

issuing_organization: Executive Engineer, CED-IV, CCU (For and on behalf of the President of India)

scope.text: Construction of open dais, green room & washrooms at Phool bagan in front of CESC Garden.
Repairing and replacement of 2km barbed wire on the boundary wall of AJCBIBG from Howrah main gate to bakultala gate.
Electrical (E) & Mechanical (M) works including installation, wiring, conduits, switches, fixtures, and related systems.

key_requirements.text: Bidders must submit detail of associated agencies for specialized component(s) to Engineer-in-Charge within prescribed time.
Bidder must deposit earnest money in the form of Insurance Surety Bonds, Account Payee Demand Draft, Fixed Deposit Receipt, Banker's Cheque or Bank Guarantee.
Contractor must submit a list of safety measures for manpower deployment to the Engineer-in-Charge for approval within two weeks of award.

eligibility.text: Bidders must declare that eligible similar work(s) has/have not been executed through another contractor on a back-to-back basis to avoid future debarment in CCU, MoEF&CC.
The tenderer must either satisfy eligibility conditions for E&M components themselves or associate with agencies fulfilling these requirements.

important_dates.text: Last date and time for submission of the bid is 3 PM on 14/01/2025.
The financial bid shall be opened at 03:30 PM on 14/01/2025.

commercial_requirements.text: Invites online Percentage rate bids; GST and Labour-Cess etc. as applicable shall be borne by the contractor himself.
Earnest money is Rs.99,229.00/-; Performance Guarantee is 5.00% of the tendered amount.
Overheads and profits are calculated at 15% on cost of materials and labour.

project_duration.text: Time allowed for carrying out the work will be 08 (Eight) months from the date of start as defined in schedule 'F' or from the first date of handing over of the site, whichever is later.

important_conditions.text: Confidentiality and non-disclosure obligations apply; Government has agreed to accept an irrevocable Bank Guarantee for Earnest Money Deposit from the Contractor.
The guarantor will not be responsible for leakage caused by earthquake or structural defects or misuse; decision of the Engineer-in-Charge with regard to nature and cause of defect shall be final.

Any sub-standard material/work beyond set out tolerance limit shall be summarily rejected by the Engineer-in-charge & contractor shall be bound to replace / remove such sub-standard / defective work immediately.
